title: PageIndex R2L Evidence Crosswalk and PDF Ingestion
constraints: Start with dry-run previews and explicit validation gates
Promote safety rules into executable DAG nodes, not prose-only constraints
Preserve user data surfaces: do not mutate vaults, trackers, or remote systems until dry-run plans pass
Emit machine-readable artifacts agents can resume
Every high-risk write, sync, or release node must declare observable acceptance criteria

metadata.outcome: Safe PageIndex ingestion with async R2L readiness, manifest validation, idempotency, and rollback/reconcile paths

nodes.title: Inventory local PDFs and remote PageIndex folders
nodes.content: List local PDFs, existing remote docs, R2L status, folder IDs, and deletion/reupload constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: Dry-run inventory shows exact create/update/remove set

safety.rollbackPlan: Restore from checkpoint artifact or stop with a partial-failure manifest if not reversible.

nodes.title: Index canonical vault SAQ, LO, and MCQ IDs
nodes.content: Build the destination identifier inventory that the evidence crosswalk must target.
acceptanceCriteria: Every target ID has canonical path and type

nodes.title: Segment large PDFs into topic-level documents
nodes.content: Use the PageIndex CLI segmentation plan to split high-density notes into stable topic PDFs with deterministic names and page ranges.

nodes.title: Validate segment names and page continuity
nodes.content: Check deterministic names, duplicate collisions, page-range continuity, and source checksum linkage.
acceptanceCriteria: Every segment maps to a source checksum and page range

safety.rollbackPlan: Restore from checkpoint artifact or stop with a partial-failure manifest if not reversible.

nodes.title: Run one-document upload and R2L smoke test
nodes.content: Apply one minimal upload with R2L enabled before any batch remote mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: R2L status can be observed or timeout is recorded

safety.rollbackPlan: Restore from checkpoint artifact or stop with a partial-failure manifest if not reversible.

nodes.title: Upload or update batch with R2L enabled
nodes.content: Batch upload with R2L and folder placement; avoid destructive deletion unless API behavior and rollback are proven.
acceptanceCriteria: Dry-run target hash matches apply target hash
Every mutation has document or error record

safety.rollbackPlan: Restore from checkpoint artifact or stop with a partial-failure manifest if not reversible.

nodes.title: Poll asynchronous R2L readiness
nodes.content: Poll PageIndex until R2L/OCR is ready or a bounded timeout produces retry/reconcile instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: Every uploaded doc has ready, failed, or timed-out status

safety.rollbackPlan: Restore from checkpoint artifact or stop with a partial-failure manifest if not reversible.

nodes.title: Capture PageIndex IDs, R2L state, and anchors
nodes.content: Persist document IDs, fileName, folder, page ranges, and OCR/R2L readiness into a local manifest.

nodes.title: Validate manifest and idempotency
nodes.content: Check duplicate IDs, missing file names, stale folders, schema validity, and rerun idempotency.
acceptanceCriteria: Second dry-run predicts no unintended duplicates

safety.rollbackPlan: Restore from checkpoint artifact or stop with a partial-failure manifest if not reversible.

nodes.title: Build SAQ/LO/MCQ evidence crosswalk
nodes.content: Map PageIndex documents and page anchors onto vault SAQs, learning objectives, MCQs, and future answer generation bundles.

nodes.title: Validate crosswalk quality thresholds
nodes.content: Check that every mapped item has document ID, page/range, source PDF checksum, confidence, and review status.
acceptanceCriteria: Unmapped and low-confidence rows are reported

safety.rollbackPlan: Restore from checkpoint artifact or stop with a partial-failure manifest if not reversible.

nodes.title: Audit drift and unresolved sources
nodes.content: Detect missing file names, API remove failures, unmapped documents, duplicate IDs, stale R2L statuses, and changed remote state.
acceptanceCriteria: Drift report lists missing names, duplicates, stale R2L state, and unresolved sources
Each drift item has reconcile, retry, or accept decision

safety.rollbackPlan: Restore from checkpoint artifact or stop with a partial-failure manifest if not reversible.

nodes.title: Rollback or reconcile partial remote state
nodes.content: If drift or partial upload is detected, emit exact rollback/reconcile commands instead of pretending success.

safety.rollbackPlan: Execute this node as the rollback/reconcile plan from the partial-failure manifest.

acceptanceCriteria: Partial-failure manifest identifies affected PageIndex IDs and local artifacts
Each item has rollback, reconcile, retry, or not-reversible decision

edges.description: remote mutation must match the dry-run target hash
anchors are captured only after ready/failed/timed-out state is known
valid manifests enable reproducible citation anchors
